title: The Royal Rivalry, Episode 1: Who Is the Greatest? (full episode)
series: The Royal Rivalry (Clash of Clans fan comic), full episodes
sources: Original fan story. Characters and art: official Supercell Fan Kit (https://fankit.supercell.com), used under Supercell's Fan Content Policy: unofficial, not endorsed by Supercell.

lines: Every legend begins somewhere. This one begins in the dark, with a pair of eyes that should not be there.
Welcome, traveller. Strong walls, tall towers, plenty of gold. And people who are, mostly, happy.
Gates secure! Nobody gets past us!
Towers clear. Eyes on the hills.
And our Wizards mostly set things on fire by accident.
Make way! Make way for the Barbarian King!
Loud, brave, and always the first to charge. Usually before anyone has finished the plan.
Plans are for people who can't punch!
All hail the Archer Queen! She has never missed a shot!
Eleven thousand bullseyes. But who's counting? Me. I am counting.
Morning. You have breakfast in your beard.
They arrived on the very same day. At the very same gate. At the very same moment.
By half a step. Which you tripped over.
Back then, this was a few huts and a fence. Those two built all of this. Together.
Together? Don't let them hear you say that.
Oh, I would never. They'd argue about who said it first.
Again! Swing like you mean it! Faster! LOUDER!
Arrows! A real hero fights up close, where the danger is!
A real hero fights where she won't get her crown dented.
My crown has NEVER been dented!
Lunch is served! Power pancakes! Hero skewers! And a cake shaped like the Clan Castle!
Uh oh. There's only one pancake left.
That pancake is mine. I trained all morning.
I hit twenty bullseyes. Before breakfast.
Oh no. They're both reaching for it.
Well. The pancake did not survive.
I'll, uh, go get a mop.
Order! Order! The council proposes a statue of the kingdom's greatest hero, right here in the square!
Ah. I was worried this would happen.

caps.text: I was worried this would happen.

lines: And there goes the whole village. Picking sides.
Place your bets! Place your bets!
And fifty, from me, on them both falling into the fountain.
Psst. Nobody's watching. Grab what you can.
Ooh, shiny. And shiny. And very, very shiny.
Has anyone seen my coin purse?
I have charged into a hundred battles!
And I won them for you, from the back.
I could beat you with one hand!
You'd need the other one to find your sword.
A duel! A duel in the square!
Wait! I can't stop! I can't stooop!
Ha! Look at you, you're soaking... whoa, whoa, WHOA!
Again? This is the fourth time this week.
A hero is not measured by how loud they shout, or how many arrows they count.
A hero is measured by what they do when the kingdom needs them.
Very well. A contest. The next time goblins raid this kingdom, whoever stops them, alone, will be named its greatest hero.
And the statue goes to the winner!
Eleven seconds now. They're both squeezing.
You charge into everything, my friend. One day, you will charge into something you cannot punch.
You never miss. But you never let anyone stand beside you, either.
People beside me get in the way of my shots.
Sharper! Sharp enough to slice through a rumour!
Thirty-nine. Forty. Restrung forty times. Just to be sure.
Hmm. If I were a goblin, I'd sneak in right... here.
I can see your entire body.

caps.text: The gold storage, the day before

lines: Is she still awake? She's still awake.
He's still awake. Of course he is.
Do you really think a contest will fix those two?
No. But it might show them what they cannot do alone.
And if the kingdom pays the price while they learn?
Then I will be there to catch it. I always am.
Boss, we've raided this kingdom forty times.
Which makes forty-one my lucky number. I can feel it.
Listen up! Tonight, we hit the gold storage.
What about the King and Queen?
Rule one: don't wake the King. Rule two: definitely don't annoy the Queen.
Rule three. What was rule three?
We're in! Look at all this gold!
HEY! You pinned my cape! Unpin me this instant!
Fill every pocket! Fill every hat!
Boss, I've run out of pockets.
Pockets full! Hat full! Ears... full!
That little one has the most gold. This one is MINE!
Thanks for the gold! Same time next week?
Oh dear. Oh dear, oh dear. It's nearly empty.
Two heroes. Twenty goblins. And not a single one caught.
So, um. Who pays out my bet now?
Technically, they both fell in the fountain. I win.
Forty-one! I told you! Lucky number!
Boss, can I take the coins out of my ears now?
No. Those are lucky coins now.
Neither of you won this contest. The kingdom lost it.
You were great, my King. Mostly.
Your aim was perfect, my Queen.
The statue stone is still waiting. Uncarved.
Waiting for a hero who has earned it.
Hey. Nice shot, earlier. On the cape.
Two halves of one hero. If only they knew it.
That wind. Cold, from the hills. It smells of lightning.
Far beyond the walls, on top of a storm-dark hill, something had watched the whole thing. And it was smiling.
To be continued. Who do you think is watching from that hill? Tell me in the comments. And like and subscribe, so you don't miss the next part.
